cards.audioText: B: [Your callsign is CSN3235, a flight from Beijing to Shanghai. You’re parking at 217, you’ve got information G. Contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你的呼号是南方3235，一架从北京飞往上海的航班，你现在在217号机位，你收到了通播G，联系北京放行，请求管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN3235, gate 217, information G, request ATC clearance to Shanghai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，南方3235，217机位，请求飞往上海的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route, departure runway 08L, LMN41 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9200m, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，可以经由计划航路飞往上海，起飞跑道08左，LMN41离场，初始爬升1500米，巡航高度9200米，起飞后，联系119.8，应答机3223。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route, departure runway 08L, LMN41 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9200m, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往上海，起飞跑道08左，LMN41离场，初始爬升1500米，巡航高度9200米，起飞后，联系119.8，应答机3223，南方3235。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, your slot time is 0800, expect 15 minutes delay due temporary airway restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，你的离场时间是0800，由于当前航路限制，预计15分钟延误。
cards.referenceText: Roger, slot time 0800, expect 15 minutes delay, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，离场时间0800，预计15分钟延误，南方3235。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, the airway restriction has been cancelled, report ready for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，航路限制已取消，准备好开车时报。

cards.audioText: B: [All the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed. You’re fully ready.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【所有乘客已经登机，所有舱门已关闭，你现在完全准备好了。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, all the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed. We’re fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，南方3235，所有乘客已经登机，所有舱门已经关闭，我们已经完全准备好了。
北京地面，南方3235，请求推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, pushback approved, facing south.
B: [Now you’ve completed the pushback, you’re ready for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在完成推出，准备好滑行了。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，南方3235，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, taxi via T4, D and A to holding point of runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，经由滑行道T4，D和A，滑行至跑道08左外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via T4, D and A to holding point of runway 08L, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道T4，D和A，滑行至跑道08左外等待点，南方3235。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re holding short of runway 08L, you’re ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在在跑道08左的外等待点，你准备好起飞了，联系北京塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN3235, holding point of runway 08L, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，南方3235，跑道08左的外等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, line up runway 08L and cleared for takeoff. Caution strong wind shear at the departure end of the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，上跑道08左等待，可以起飞，注意跑道一边（起飞边）上有强风切变。
cards.referenceText: Line up runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, roger, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道08左等待，可以起飞，收到，南方3235。

cards.audioText: B: [Just after the liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200m. Report it to Beijing Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【离地后，你在地面和高度200之间遇到了强风切变，报告给北京离场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3235, we encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，南方3235，我们在地面和高度200之间遇到了强风切变。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, climb to 4200m, resume own navigation to LMN.
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4200m, resume own navigation to LMN, CSN3235.

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, continue climb to 5100, contact Beijing Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，继续上5100米，联系北京区调118.9。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 5100, contact Beijing Control on 118.9, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续上5100米，联系北京区调118.9，南方3235。
